input: # The version core: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, three numeric identifiers.
# A zero is a numeric identifier on its own; only a LEADING zero is banned.
# The specification puts no upper bound on an integer; these are exact
# and still within Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER (2^53 - 1), so a number in
# both runtimes. Larger values become bigint / *big.Int, which JSON
# cannot carry — those cases live in ts/test/semver.test.ts and
